patterns: do not wait for the driver to assign an id
pass is not a successor trigger
stage pass does not imply successor

semantic_review_requirements: For foundation-facing tasks, enforce foundational_logic.json before freezing native premises or importing successful effective/classical definitions.
When engineering success is used, separate effective definitions withheld from native premises from engineering-success constraints consumed as evidence.
Target-side definitions copied into native premises invalidate the claimed foundational derivation unless separately declared or derived at the correct semantic strength.
A raw free-research axiom candidate is not Driver-taskbook dispatchable; taskbook creation requires the candidate lifecycle to have reached Driver intake when the task originates from free discovery.
FREE researchers may nevertheless publish a non-dispatchable Scheduler V2 task proposal into REVIEW_PENDING; publication is not Driver approval or Working Truth.
If origin_kind=FREE_AXIOM_CANDIDATE, preserve the audited candidate id/state. Repackaging the same origin as DRIVER_ROADMAP is provenance laundering and fails review.
For task_lineage=CONTINUATION, audit the successor gate rather than accepting parent PASS, stage numbering, momentum or recent success as the reason for another stage.
Any obvious Stage 2+ task is CONTINUATION. More generally, renaming the next unresolved layer of the same parent route does not reset semantic lineage.
Continuation review must record whether closure, another owner/route or independent/free exploration was considered; no numeric exploration quota is imposed.
Working Truth is a task-execution discipline and must not be retroactively applied to Phase-A discovery or Phase-B prior-art/dedup audit.
Ordinary task execution inherits tool_invocation_policy.json and must reuse/combine/extend adequate existing tools before inventing new general-purpose machinery.

A taskbook with an explicit blind-forward/source-whitelist discovery firewall may delay current toolbox/method visibility only until its named raw candidate/no-go freeze point; the same task must run current-tool dedup after that freeze.
FREE Phase A follows the same discovery-firewall timing principle: no current toolbox prior before freeze; mandatory current-tool dedup in Phase B after freeze.
Taskbooks that inherit final-response identity behavior are version-coupled to final_response_identity_policy.json.
Taskbook policy PASS is only the content gate. Scheduler V2 PUBLISH plus cross-Driver APPROVE is the runtime READY gate; direct V2 DONE is forbidden and returns close only after cross-Driver REVIEW.

research_control_state_machine.json is the cross-layer composition contract around Scheduler V2. Before a control-plane verdict, validate information-firewall state, evidence/admission state, method-harvest classification, route disposition, successor/replication provenance, and parent-objective liveness at the profile strength actually claimed.

New Scheduler V2 APPROVE events must bind taskbook_audit=PASS and the current policy_digest; new REVIEW events must bind evidence_class, method_harvest, route_disposition, and any route-specific successor/child/Foundation/formalization/promotion reference required by research_control_state_machine.json.

Independent replication is never a same-task HANDOFF_READY transition. The reviewed parent is parked/closed as appropriate and a distinct child task with explicit independence/firewall provenance is authored, reviewed, published, and claimed in a fresh execution context.
